tasks.subject: Task 1: project.yml -- URL schemes + documented build-variant toggle
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Register the URL schemes both build variants need, and document (without changing default behavior) exactly how to flip project.yml into the self-signed/LocalDevVPN variant.

**Files:**
- Modify: tools/sogen-ios/project.yml

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] LSApplicationQueriesSchemes includes localdevvpn
- [ ] CFBundleURLTypes registers the sogenios scheme
- [ ] TunnelExtension dependency and GCC_PREPROCESSOR_DEFINITIONS unchanged in effective value (comments only)
- [ ] xcodegen generate succeeds

**Verify:** cd tools/sogen-ios && xcodegen generate -> exits 0, no diff to target dependencies/embedded frameworks

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tools/sogen-ios/project.yml"], "verifyCommand": "cd tools/sogen-ios && xcodegen generate", "acceptanceCriteria": ["LSApplicationQueriesSchemes includes localdevvpn", "CFBundleURLTypes registers sogenios scheme", "default build behavior unchanged"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: LocalDevVPNManager.swift -- the LocalDevVPN tunnel mechanism
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A new, self-contained manager that establishes the JIT-grant tunnel via LocalDevVPN's URL-scheme handshake instead of TunnelExtension.

**Files:**
- Create: tools/sogen-ios/Sources/JIT/LocalDevVPNManager.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Exposes LocalDevVPNResult (.connected/.notInstalled/.failed(String)) and LocalDevVPNManager.ensureConnected(completion:)
- [ ] Detects not-installed via UIApplication.shared.canOpenURL against localdevvpn:// with zero network attempt
- [ ] Opens localdevvpn://enable?scheme=sogenios when installed
- [ ] Exposes LocalDevVPNManager.handleCallback() resolving .connected
- [ ] 8s timeout resolves .failed(...) instead of hanging forever
- [ ] Builds cleanly as part of the SogenIOS target

**Verify:** cd tools/sogen-ios && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project SogenIOS.xcodeproj -scheme SogenIOS -sdk iphoneos -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO build -> ** BUILD SUCCEEDED **

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tools/sogen-ios/Sources/JIT/LocalDevVPNManager.swift"], "verifyCommand": "cd tools/sogen-ios && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project SogenIOS.xcodeproj -scheme SogenIOS -sdk iphoneos -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["LocalDevVPNResult and ensureConnected exist with correct shape", "not-installed short-circuits before any network attempt", "8s timeout produces .failed", "builds cleanly"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Route the sogenios:// callback
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Wire LocalDevVPN's completion callback (sogenios://) to LocalDevVPNManager.handleCallback().

**Files:**
- Modify: tools/sogen-ios/Sources/SogenApp.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Opening a sogenios:// URL while running calls LocalDevVPNManager.handleCallback()
- [ ] Any other scheme is ignored, no crash
- [ ] Builds cleanly

**Verify:** Same build command as Task 2 -> ** BUILD SUCCEEDED **. Full behavioral verification is on-device only (Task 6).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tools/sogen-ios/Sources/SogenApp.swift"], "verifyCommand": "cd tools/sogen-ios && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project SogenIOS.xcodeproj -scheme SogenIOS -sdk iphoneos -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["onOpenURL routes sogenios:// to LocalDevVPNManager.handleCallback()", "other schemes ignored safely"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: JITGateOrchestrator -- select the tunnel mechanism, richer result type
tasks.description:
**Goal:** JITGateOrchestrator.run uses TunnelManager or LocalDevVPNManager based on SOGEN_IOS_USE_LOCALDEVVPN, and reports a three-way JITGateResult instead of today's (Bool, String).

**Files:**
- Modify: tools/sogen-ios/Sources/JIT/JITGate.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] New JITGateResult enum: .success, .tunnelNotInstalled, .failed(String)
- [ ] run's completion parameter type changes to (JITGateResult) -> Void
- [ ] Default (flag unset): behavior identical to today except completion type; .tunnelNotInstalled never produced
- [ ] Flag set: LocalDevVPNManager gates the tunnel step, three-way result mapped per spec
- [ ] Shared proceedAfterTunnel logic, not duplicated between branches
- [ ] runXcodeDebuggerBypass's completion type updated to JITGateResult too

**Verify:** Build with flag unset (default) -- expected to fail until Task 5 lands (ContentView still uses old signature); this is expected, not a Task 4 bug. Isolated syntax validity confirmed by Task 5's build.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tools/sogen-ios/Sources/JIT/JITGate.swift"], "verifyCommand": "see Task 5 -- ContentView must be updated in the same pass before a full build succeeds", "acceptanceCriteria": ["JITGateResult defined with 3 cases", "default branch behavior unchanged besides completion type", "LocalDevVPN branch maps 3-way result correctly", "no duplicated post-tunnel logic"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: ContentView -- handle JITGateResult, add the LocalDevVPN install prompt
tasks.description:
**Goal:** ContentView.attemptBoot's two completion handlers switch on JITGateResult; a new UI state shows an Install LocalDevVPN / Retry prompt for .tunnelNotInstalled.

**Files:**
- Modify: tools/sogen-ios/Sources/ContentView.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] .success -> startEmulator(with: layer), unchanged from today
- [ ] .failed(message) -> same on-screen ERROR: line as today, unchanged wording
- [ ] .tunnelNotInstalled -> new state shows Install LocalDevVPN / Retry buttons
- [ ] Developer-signed default build's visible behavior is unchanged

**Verify:** cd tools/sogen-ios && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project SogenIOS.xcodeproj -scheme SogenIOS -sdk iphoneos -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO build -> ** BUILD SUCCEEDED **. Then temporarily flip to the LocalDevVPN variant, confirm it ALSO builds, then revert to default before committing.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tools/sogen-ios/Sources/ContentView.swift"], "verifyCommand": "cd tools/sogen-ios && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project SogenIOS.xcodeproj -scheme SogenIOS -sdk iphoneos -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["three-way switch handles all JITGateResult cases", "default build behavior unchanged", "both build variants compile", "project.yml reverted to default state before commit"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Real-device verification (both build variants)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Confirm both build variants actually work on real hardware.

It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. - [ ] Install LocalDevVPN, tap Retry: tunnel handshake completes, JIT grant proceeds, guest boots to [ngcs] done (all 8 frames)
- [ ] Developer-signed build: still boots via TunnelExtension unchanged (regression check)
